claims: Davey Lopes was a Los Angeles Dodgers second baseman.
Davey Lopes was a four-time All-Star.
Davey Lopes died at the age of 80.
Davey Lopes passed away in Rhode Island.
Davey Lopes' cause of death was complications from Parkinson’s disease.
Rhode Island was Davey Lopes' home state.
Davey Lopes was surrounded by family when he died.
Davey Lopes was a member of the Dodgers' 1970s/80s infield.
Davey Lopes was a 1981 World Series champion.
Davey Lopes had 557 career stolen bases.
